premises.name: Ball-Rogozin scalar product-projection bound
premises.scope: For independent cap-one original coordinates, ||p_(a^T X)||_infinity <= sqrt(2)/||a||_2; no support or moment assumptions.

premises.name: account04/B14 r10 scale-covariant three-coordinate Schur localization
premises.scope: Three independent cap-one variables, invertible symmetric 3x3 matrix H, arbitrary affine leakage; essential density height <=6sqrt(pi)/sigma_min(H).

result.statement: If original coordinates split into disjoint banks I1,I2,I3 and outside J, A_II=U B U^T and A_IJ=U C with U columns u_r supported on I_r, R=diag(||u_r||_2), and B symmetric invertible, then ||p_(X^TAX)||_(infinity,ess) <=12sqrt(pi)/sigma_min(RBR). Arbitrary deterministic coordinate shifts, outside curvature, aligned exterior coupling, fragments, tails and unbounded supports cost zero. Additional affine perturbations are covered when their active-bank component lies in col(U), with arbitrary outside component.

partner_application: For three equal-size diffuse banks and B_*=I-(2/3)11^T, every physical triple is singular or has sigma_min=1/m, so direct r10 costs 6sqrt(pi)m; after Ball-Rogozin bank compression and r10 on the three scalar bank variables, the bound is 12sqrt(pi) uniformly in m.
scope_correction: The initial draft said arbitrary added affine perturbations. The proof only covers arbitrary coordinate translations (whose induced active-bank affine term automatically lies in col(U)) and, more generally, added affine terms with active-bank component in col(U). The canonical report and checks were corrected before final delivery.
branch_continuity: NOT_CLAIMED; partner r10 source is essential-height only
unresolved_implication: Derive under bare s_3(A)>=1 either a paid existing chamber or a bank compression with universally controlled sigma_min(RBR), or prove an overlap-preserving compiler tolerating orthogonal within-bank residuals without conditioning away product provenance.
next_step: Attack the residual-coupling version: quantify how much A_II and A_IJ may deviate from UBU^T and UC while retaining a bank-first estimate, using an Lp or cross-volume resource before inverse physical-minor payment.
